friction.summary: signLoanSetByCounterparty in xrpl.js 5.1.0 signed the counterparty signature with the wrong hash prefix, so rippled rejected it; fixed only in 5.2.0-beta.1
Broker owner, vault owner, LoanSet counterparty signer and cover funder must be one account, so a wallet created vault can never lend and a custodial desk had to own every object
tecNO_PERMISSION covered at least six distinct causes this session, including escrow to a non member of the token's permissioned domain, a cause absent from XLS-0085
High precision fields round trip in scientific notation: DebtMaximum written as 1000000000000 reads back as 1e12, which BigInt rejects, breaking every market created that way

The documented lending devnet host lend.devnet.rippletest.net does not resolve, there is no documented programmatic faucet, and the closed ended vault and cash basis loan specs live only in unmerged PRs
OfferCreate TakerGets and TakerPays exclude MPT amounts, so XLS-65 vault shares cannot trade on the DEX and a bespoke escrow order book was required
VaultClawback needs the underlying asset to permit clawback, which XRP never does, so a vault owner cannot wind down a market holding other people's deposits
LoanBrokerDelete succeeds while the vault still holds deposits and VaultDelete then fails, leaving an orphaned vault with no broker

finish attempted before FinishAfter, a timing rule reported as a permission rule
the vault is open ended and that server does not allow open ended lending

the vault's underlying asset does not permit clawback
an issuer opting in to its own issuance
credential missing versus issued but not yet accepted

abandoned.blocked_at: RLUSD is Testnet only while XLS-65 and XLS-66 run on the lending devnet

abandoned.what: Custodian held share listings for gated vaults, the open order book design
abandoned.blocked_at: permissioned domain membership: the custodian cannot be admitted to every market's compliance domain, so escrowing gated shares to it returns tecNO_PERMISSION

abandoned.what: Hard deleting three vaults that still hold other people's deposits
abandoned.blocked_at: VaultClawback returns tecNO_PERMISSION because neither XRP nor an MPT minted without tfMPTCanClawback can be clawed back

workarounds.what: A custodial desk owning every vault, broker and loan, with the creator recorded off protocol in the vault Data field
Manual CPT prefix signing for the LoanSet counterparty signature
A parser that expands scientific notation before any XRPL number is converted to BigInt or formatted
A bespoke escrow based order book for vault shares because the DEX cannot quote MPTs
Crawling a broker pseudo account to read its loan book and crawling known accounts to discover vaults, since neither is indexed
Overriding navigator.onLine so the bundled WalletConnect will attempt its relay instead of refusing offline
Manual ceiling of decimal loan values to integer token units for MPT vault repayments

single_fix: Ship the corrected signLoanSetByCounterparty, the one that applies the CPT prefix, in a stable xrpl.js release, and make temBAD_SIGNER on LoanSet say that the counterparty signature is missing or wrongly prefixed instead of reporting signer duplication. That single issue accounted for a measured 5859 seconds, the largest cost in the session, and every team building on XLS-66 meets it.

Not reproducible and not attributed to any protocol behaviour.
